Responses recorded on 2026-10-17 from https://appscdn.joomla.org/webapps/ (release=6.0, product
Joomla, lang en-GB). The dashboard one is cut to its first three extensions.

They show the structure the current directory produces. They are NOT the markup the Joomla 6
client reads (it expects ids and data attributes these responses do not have, see
docs/install-from-web.md), so they are used to compare the parts both share: the category
sidebar, the ordering options, the breadcrumb, the cards and the empty-search message.
